title: extract_did_sig searches body bytes, not headers only
description: crates/reader/src/session/lifecycle.rs lines 538-540 and crates/reader/src/post/did_passthrough.rs: has_did_sig() and extract_did_sig() are called with article_bytes (the full raw article including headers, blank line, and body). Both functions iterate every line in the input. A body line beginning with 'x-usenet-ipfs-did-sig:' (case-insensitive) would be misidentified as the DID-Sig header value. This is a security-relevant correctness bug: an attacker can craft a body that spoofs the DID-Sig header, causing the server to attempt to verify a signature of the attacker's choosing against article content that was not actually signed. Correct behavior: extract_did_sig and has_did_sig must search only the header section (bytes before the first CRLFCRLF or LFLF separator). The lifecycle.rs call sites should pass only header_bytes, or the functions must stop at the blank-line separator.
